Q: Apply list of functions over enum encapsulated variants A:

From should only perform a conversion, I would discourage doing other application specific code in From. If you really want implement this design, you might want to specify your own trait.

Q: Remove rows conditionally if one column does not include a set of required strings within groups defined by another column, in R A:

You can use ave within subset like below

subset(
    df,
    !as.integer(ave(colour,
        group,
        FUN = \(x) length(setdiff(required_list, x))
    ))
)

or

subset(
    df,
    ave(
        match(colour, required_list),
        group,
        FUN = \(x) length(unique(x))
    ) == length(required_list)
)

which should give

   individual group colour
1           1     A    Red
2           2     A   Blue
6           6     C    Red
7           7     C   Blue
8           8     D    Red
9           9     D    Red
10         10     D   Blue
